instructions: Classify which of Nielsen's five usability quality components the review talks about. Only mark a component if the review discusses it explicitly; ignore price, ads and pure bug reports.

labels.name: Learnability
labels.definition: How easy it is for new users to accomplish basic tasks the first time they use the app.
labels.examples: I figured it out in a minute.

labels.name: Efficiency
labels.definition: How quickly users can perform tasks once they have learned the app (number of taps, shortcuts, speed of workflows).
labels.examples: Logging food takes too many taps.

labels.name: Memorability
labels.definition: How easily users re-establish proficiency after not using the app, or after a redesign moved things.
labels.examples: After the update I can't find anything.

labels.name: Errors
labels.definition: How many mistakes users make, how severe they are, and how easily they can recover from them.
labels.examples: Buttons too close, I keep tapping the wrong one.

labels.name: Satisfaction
labels.definition: How pleasant the design is to use; aesthetic or emotional comments about the interface.
